# Semester dates summary

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Orientation | 19–27 Feb | 18–26 Feb | 17–25 Feb |
| Semester one<br>teaching period | **2 Mar – 26 Jun** | **1 Mar – 25 Jun** | **28 Feb – 23 Jun** |
| Mid-semester break | 6–10 Apr | 29 Mar – 2 Apr | 17–21  Apr |
| Orientation (mid-year) | 20–24 Jul | 19–23 Jul | 17–21 Jul |

### Teaching period definitions
Beginning in 2025, teaching periods comprise twelve teaching weeks, a mid-semester break, swot vac, and the final assessment period.
